name: Sun Plan
description: An invented payer's rules, to show what a pack can say.

A4.why: Sun Plan pays a line dated outside the statement period, with a remark.

rules.why: Sun Plan denies claims received more than 90 days after the service (CARC 29).
Sun Plan needs prior authorization for 60-minute psychotherapy (CARC 197 without it).
Sun Plan pays telehealth visits only with modifier 95.
